summary: Reel hooks fail (77% drop in 3s); chatbot posts earn 24% of lead_gen per reach. Bio violates rules: niche list, region, '24 hrs', free offer outside website posts.
guidance:
- Try comparison or contrast hooks (lead_gen outperforms; contrast 1.75x, comparison 1.56x) instead of question hooks (0.4x angle, 21% of comparison per reach).
- Avoid "Will AI look fake?" or generic question openings; they've repeated and underperform.
- Show real dev work: share a code snippet, config logic, or integration flowchart — not a demo link.
- Keep captions conversational, end with "DM if this fits your workflow."

instructions.research: Find 2-3 common chatbot integration pain points Indian small businesses mention in public forums (e.g., WhatsApp Business API limits, language switching, handoff to human).
instructions.analysis: Compare last 4 chatbot posts' hook styles vs engagement; note which style (question/comparison/contrast) got most saves/shares.
instructions.writer: Write a comparison-style caption: contrast manual WhatsApp replies vs a bot handling FAQs while owner serves walk-ins; end with 'DM if this fits your workflow.'
instructions.image: Create a split-screen graphic: left side 'Manual replies' (cluttered chat), right side 'Bot handles FAQs' (clean flow); use desk-glow style.
instructions.video: Skip reel today; static image carousel performs better for chatbot topic. If video needed, film a 5-sec timelapse of coding a bot flow (no business-specific logic).

manual_tips: Fix Instagram bio: remove niche list, region, '24 hrs', and free site check offer. Replace with: 'AI chatbots, animated ads, lead gen & websites for Indian small businesses. Pay after approval. DM to chat.'
Comment on 5 posts by Indian small business owners (cafes, gyms, clinics) discussing WhatsApp overload; add value, don't pitch.
Reply to every story mention or tag within 2 hours to build familiarity.
